review.notes: Code fences are balanced (two txt blocks for the harmony-format Figures 17-18; the PDF itself labels them 'Figure'). Line- and word-level diff of the extracted text of all 35 physical pages against the OCR Markdown found exactly three dropped footnote bodies (markers survived in the text and in the Table 4 cell); all three were transcribed from the PDF text layer and visually confirmed on 120 dpi renders of physical pages 5, 13 and 15. Benchmark numbers on physical pages 6-8 and 10 that are absent from the Markdown live inside the embedded Figure 1-3 chart images (the PDF has no text layer there and no dropped table). Apparent missing words on pages 12/20/27/31/32/34 are PDF-side line-break hyphenations ('trou-bleshooting', 'attention-is-off-by-one', 'A. Weli-hinda') whose joined forms are present in the Markdown. The three Markdown escapes (o200k\_harmony, not\_unsafe x2) reproduce the printed underscores verbatim and were left unchanged. Reference list [1]-[30] is complete; Table 1/4/7 values and the 'Figure 16' bare label match the rendered pages.
